items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: She said, that's my trumpet player... I said, huh, just like that. She said, did you know there's something I was going to say, you know? She said, what I was going to say? I said, that's your boyfriend?

ctx.x: It's all set going. You might give your names first so we'll have that on the tape. Do you want to start, Billy? Tell us, give your name first and then your family before you were married.

Oh, yeah. Oh, before I was married, I was a good son. Now since I got married, I'm named Willie Madison Pierce, but I still use that good son over there too right on. And I have three sisters living. It was seven of us, but just only three living now. Which ones are living now? Well, Sadie, she is living. She's the oldest one living. Is she still in New York? No, Sadie's in Detroit. Oh, Detroit. I don't even know. And then Edna, she's next to Sadie. She's in Florida. And I had also my baby sister, she was in…
Yeah, I was born in Florida. Was that Pensacola? I was born in Mariana, Florida. Oh, Mariana.
